publicTitle: Can Someone Else Pick Up the Work?
question: Can another operator recover what happened, what evidence exists, what failed, what remains unresolved and what may lawfully happen next?
comparator: Dependence on principal-operator private memory; decisive future comparator is a clean unaffiliated operator/repository transfer.
procedure: provide durable state without private conversational memory
require successor to recover current state failures evidence boundaries and lawful next actions
compare recovered identities and dispositions with frozen record
fail transfer if continuation requires undisclosed private memory or silently changes meaning
environment: Repository-state recovery and handoff method; the external test is operator/repository transfer rather than identical production runtime recreation.
acceptanceCriteria: An external transfer passes only if an unaffiliated operator can recover the bounded state and lawful continuation without inherited private memory or semantic drift.
verifier: Identity/disposition comparison against the durable record; current public standing remains internal until an unaffiliated transfer is executed.
knownGaps: clean unaffiliated operator reproduction not observed
proprietaryBoundary: Only state required to reproduce the bounded custody/succession claim must be exposed; any necessary hidden dependency must be declared as a gap rather than silently assumed.
claimCeiling: Demonstrated internal custody and succession mechanics only; no clean unaffiliated reproduction, cross-repository transfer, organization-level portability or inference that transfer validates underlying science.
